Package index

Running the pipeline

Run an OMOP-ES pipeline, optionally at a particular commit of the OMOP-ES repository so that two versions can be compared.

omop_es_run()
Run OMOP-ES in a separate process
omop_es_run_git_sha()
Run OMOP-ES at a particular git branch or commit
omop_es_main_cuh_interactive()
Run the OMOP-ES pipeline in the current process

Loading extracts into duckdb

Register an OMOP-ES extract as a set of duckdb views, so that it can be queried with dplyr and dbplyr without copying any data.

duckdb_register_omop_es_output()
Register OMOP-ES output as duckdb views
duckdb_register_omop_es_datalake()
Register a data-lake directory of parquet files as duckdb views
dbListOmopTables()
List the OMOP tables in a schema

Downloading OMOP vocabularies

Download the OMOP vocabulary tables as parquet from the published omop-vocabs-processed releases, and register them in duckdb. This gets the vocabularies without an OMOP-ES checkout or a database, and works in the browser under webR as well as locally.

omop_vocab_download()
Download published OMOP vocabulary tables
duckdb_register_omop_vocabs()
Register downloaded OMOP vocabularies as duckdb views
omop_vocab_dir()
Directory in which downloaded OMOP vocabularies are kept
omop_vocab_parquet_url()
URL of a published OMOP vocabulary parquet file
omop_vocab_processed_tables()
Vocabulary tables published as parquet by omop-vocabs-processed

Browsing and diffing extracts

Shiny applications for looking at what the pipeline produced, and for comparing two extracts row by row.

omop_es_viewer()
Browse a single OMOP-ES extract
omop_es_diff_viewer()
Browse the differences between two OMOP-ES extracts
omop_es_diff_viewer_local_git()
Run OMOP-ES for two git SHAs and compare

Generate documentation for an OMOP-ES extract

Recover the SQL queries, source database tables and hand-written documentation belonging to each OMOP-ES plugin, by running the plugins with database access stubbed out, and render the result as a report describing what an extract contains and where it came from.

omop_es_extract_summary_report()
Render an OMOP-ES extract summary report
omop_es_plugins_extract_sql()
Extract SQL queries for all OMOP-ES plugins
omop_es_plugins_extract_tables()
Extract database tables used by each OMOP-ES plugin
omop_es_plugins_extract_docs_public()
Load all table-level public documentation Markdown files
omop_es_plugins_extract_docs_private()
Load all table-level private documentation Markdown files
omop_es_plugins_extract_metadata()
Extract metadata about OMOP-ES plugins

Cross-tabulating concept columns

Count how each concept column of an extract has been populated, which concepts were used and which rows are unmapped. This is the material the extract summary report is built from.

omop_cross_tabulation()
Cross-tabulate the concept columns of every OMOP table
omop_table_cross_tabulation()
Cross-tabulate the concept columns of one OMOP table

Extract summary report sections

The building blocks of the extract summary report. Each returns a list of HTML named by OMOP table, which the report template interleaves into per-table sections. They are exported because the bundled R Markdown template calls them.

omop_es_extract_summary_all_tables()
Every table the extract summary report should cover
omop_es_all_tables_headings_html()
Build the per-table headings of the extract summary report
omop_es_markdown_docs_public_html()
Build the public documentation sections of the extract summary report
omop_es_markdown_docs_private_html()
Build the private documentation sections of the extract summary report
omop_es_field_level_summary_html()
Build the column-level summary sections of the extract summary report
omop_es_cross_tabulations_html()
Build the concept tabulation sections of the extract summary report
omop_es_data_provenance_html()
Build the data provenance sections of the extract summary report

Concept mapping tables

Annotate concept ids with their name, vocabulary, domain and standard-concept status, and render the result as a table or a report.

decorate_mapping_table()
Annotate the concept ids of a mapping table
gt_decorate_mapping_table()
Annotate the concept ids of a mapping table, as a gt table
mapping_table_report()
Render a concept mapping table as a standalone HTML report

OMOP CDM metadata

The OMOP CDM v5.4 specification shipped with the package, and the table names derived from it.

omop_metadata_table_level()
Load the OMOP CDM table level definition table
omop_all_tables()
Names of every table in the OMOP CDM
omop_cdm_tables()
Names of the OMOP CDM clinical data tables
